title: Amyrteus
summary: Raleigh names Amyrteus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Amyrteus, who held part of Aegypt from the Persian, and later the Marish and Wooddie parts, one of the race of their former Kings. He is not Psammenitus, on whom Amyrtoeus was stored, and not the Cory Amyrteos. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
